# Narrow scope amendment

The existing TextEdit point ingress identifies the hit text object, but after a successful edit request leaves an earlier multi-selection intact. MSE-24 requires the owning selected root. This amendment permits the existing composition ingress as well as already-authorized Selection owners. No native IME result is synthesized, no historical package is changed, and the D07 OOM blocker remains open. The user accepted same-preparer review; this is not an independent review or Gate result.
